workUnits.title: WU9-01 Extended Docker/container operational model
workUnits.objective: Collect and normalize bounded container inspection metadata.
scope: Identity, restart policy, ports, mounts, networks, labels
outOfScope: Docker administration beyond existing lifecycle controls
acceptanceCriteria: Richer states and health are distinguishable

workUnits.title: WU9-02 Current container resource metrics
workUnits.objective: Add bounded point-in-time CPU and memory metrics.
acceptanceCriteria: Running container stats are available when supported
Missing or malformed stats do not remove metadata

workUnits.title: WU9-03 Bounded container logs
workUnits.objective: Provide safe on-demand recent container logs.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend enforces request and output bounds

workUnits.title: WU9-04 Lifecycle action hardening and Activity evidence
workUnits.objective: Verify lifecycle actions and record concise evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Failures and verification mismatches are explicit

workUnits.title: WU9-05 Container detail and operational UI
workUnits.objective: Expose details, logs, actions, and service context in the established UI.

dependencies.reason: The bounded Docker operation contract precedes logs.
Actions reuse the typed Docker boundary.
